title: File:Halcyonair ATR 42 Cape Verde 2011.jpg
author: Cayambe
description: An ATR of the Cape Verdian airline Halcyonair at Amílcar Cabral International Airport in en:Espargos, Sal, Cape Verde. The name of the airline is derived from Halcyon, a genus of kingfisher birds, of which Halcyon leucocephala is widespread in the archipelago of Cape Verde.
